description: Defines a PHP class 'http' for screen-scraping with caching capabilities, including methods for fetching HTML content, caching, and parsing HTML tables into arrays or XML.

classes.name: http
classes.description: A class for performing HTTP requests with caching and HTML table parsing functionalities.

methods.name: http
methods.description: Constructor that initializes default properties for the http class.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches content from a URL with optional caching based on TTL.

methods.name: getFromUrl
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection and initiates an HTTP GET request.

methods.name: getFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached content from a file.

methods.name: saveToCache
methods.description: Saves fetched content into a cache file.

methods.name: getFile_ts
methods.description: Gets the last modified timestamp of the cache file.

methods.name: table_into_array
methods.description: Parses an HTML table into a PHP array.

methods.name: table_into_xml
methods.description: Converts an HTML table into an XML dataset.
